description: This file defines the Psr17FactoryProvider class within the Slim framework, providing methods to get, set, and add PSR-17 factory implementations used for HTTP message creation.

classes.name: Psr17FactoryProvider
classes.description: Provides a static registry and management of PSR-17 factory classes for use within the Slim framework.

methods.name: getFactories
methods.description: Returns the current list of registered PSR-17 factory class names.

methods.name: setFactories
methods.description: Replaces the current list of factory class names with a new array.

methods.name: addFactory
methods.description: Prepends a new factory class name to the list of registered factories.
